name: What should homeowners prepare before a shower tile renovation begins?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before a shower tile renovation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a shower tile project, decide on your overall layout, tile dimensions, fixture locations, and built-in features such as storage niches or grab bars. Because plumbing fixtures and rough-in valves sit behind the wall, you must determine their placement before closing up the framing and hanging tile backer. Clear out the bathroom, ensure clear pathways for tools and debris, and verify your chosen tile is rated for wet areas. Selecting your grout color and coordinating with trades early ensures a smoother installation schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide on tile style, fixture locations, and accessory placement like niches or grab bars ahead of time so plumbing and framing adjustments happen before tiling begins.
